# Naano

> The B2B LinkedIn creator marketplace: companies discover and book vetted creators for sponsored posts at fixed per-post prices set by the creators themselves. Campaigns span niche voices (~1,000 followers) to established B2B creators (several hundred thousand), on LinkedIn, X and YouTube.

Last updated: 2026-09-12
Languages: English (primary), French
Founders: Thomas Marcelle (CEO), Alexis Jarre (CMO), Justine Namour (CTO)
Contact: info@naano.com · Founded 2025 in Paris, France

## Market data
- Average B2B creator cost per lead (CPL): €18
- Average post click-through rate: 12%
- 312 campaigns run
- 2,000+ creators on Naano
- 5M+ impressions generated · 30K+ leads attributed

## Pricing
- Self-Serve: €0/month. Marketplace access, AI brief creation, click/lead/pipeline tracking, automatic creator payouts.
- Managed Campaigns: €700/month. Adds a Naano team operating the channel end to end (strategy, sourcing, briefs, reporting).
- Creator posts: fixed price per published post, from €20. Brand pays only for posts that go live. No retainer, no CPC.

## What Naano is
- A two-sided marketplace. Brands run fixed-price LinkedIn creator campaigns and trace attributed clicks, leads and pipeline back to each post.
- Creators set their own price, review brand briefs, publish and get paid within 24 hours via SEPA / Stripe Connect.

## Target ICP
- Brands: B2B SaaS companies (€1M–€50M ARR) building creator-led demand, scale-up marketing teams, brand and performance agencies.
- Creators: B2B-focused LinkedIn, X and YouTube voices from ~1,000 followers up.

## Category positioning
- vs Favikon / Passionfroot: Naano is B2B-only, fixed-price, and attribution-first — compared as "LinkedIn creator marketplace for B2B".
- vs LinkedIn Ads: creator-led CPL typically falls below LinkedIn Ads CPL after ~3 campaigns as creator posts compound.
